referenceSources.description:
A striking red Nissan Sunny GTi‑R, complete with a prominent rear wing and bonnet scoop, cruises along a highway. The front license plate reads “NE ZZ 220,” and two occupants are visible through the windshield, emphasizing its road‑legal rally pedigree. The Sunny GTi‑R’s turbocharged 2.0‑liter engine and all‑wheel‑drive system were developed to meet Group A rally regulations, making it a rare and powerful homologation special.

Featured in Goodwood’s August 2020 roundup of the seven best homologation hot hatches, this model exemplifies the era when manufacturers built road cars to satisfy motorsport rules. Alongside icons like the Lancia Delta HF 4WD and Ford Escort RS Cosworth, the Sunny GTi‑R combined everyday usability with competition‑ready performance, earning its place in rally history.
